positive_each_side_each_distance: Across all three attempts, require real witch-owned splash spawn and potion metadata, a real Poison player effect and a separate actual harming DamageEvent type indirect_magic with cause witch+1 and direct an observed harming projectile+1. Record all attempts; no retry or selection by outcome. A missing official positive control means INCONCLUSIVE, never candidate PASS.
controls: NoAI, creative, and wall each require a valid complete observation and no splash projectile from the witch. A wall bypass, disappearance, dead player, absent mode, late command, missing live HP, missing entity, or incomplete window is INVALID, not an absence success.
timing: No exact throw count, timing, probability, velocity distribution or cross-run RNG equality; use nominal tick only to locate controlled window. Do not claim full witch AI parity.
provenance: One real witch with spawn identity; each considered potion entity must have owner=witch id and packet metadata potion_contents; impact is a real corresponding entity destroy and level event, player effect or harmful damage is real and inside observation. No synthetic IDs, missing packet, console success or inferred zero accepted as evidence.
scope: Java26.3 Normal, one stationary survival player with Resistance V, near2/far9 on explicit level floor, one witch in loaded area. Player mode, actual HP, actual movement and witch position must be documented; NoAI metadata bit and unbroken wall path must be validated. Duration is sufficient for observation, not a new timing rule.
combat_regression: Run the existing four fire-protection and thorns semantic controls once on the same candidate binary, unchanged.
source_runtime: Pin exact source commit, runtime SHA256, ELF and approved Java26.3 protocol/entity/item/block SHA; preserve raw records, server logs, lifecycle and cleanup for independent decoding.
